import importlib.util, os, sys

def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod); return mod

R = os.path.abspath('units')
csvfix = load('impl', R+'/csvfix/impl.py')
eng = load('engine', R+'/rules/engine.py')
led = load('ledger', R+'/ledger/ledger.py')
sch = load('schedule', R+'/schedule/schedule.py')
iv = load('intervals', R+'/intervals/intervals.py')
fl = load('flags', R+'/flags/flags.py')
me = load('measure', R+'/measure/measure.py')
sl = load('slugify', R+'/slugify/slugify.py')
rg = load('ranges', R+'/ranges/ranges.py')
sys.path.insert(0, R+'/chain')
s1 = load('stage1', R+'/chain/stage1.py'); s2 = load('stage2', R+'/chain/stage2.py')
s3 = load('stage3', R+'/chain/stage3.py'); s4 = load('stage4', R+'/chain/stage4.py')

print('csvfix.parse quoted:', csvfix.parse('"a,b", 2 ,x'))
print('csvfix.parse empty :', csvfix.parse(''))
try:
    csvfix.total([["a","1","x"]])
except ValueError as e:
    print('csvfix.total bad ->', type(e).__name__)
print('rules missing key :', eng.evaluate({"all":["a","zz"]}, {"a":True}))
print('rules both keys   :', eng.evaluate({"any":["b"],"all":["a"]}, {"a":True,"b":False}))
try:
    led.Ledger().apply([("deposit","a",1),("deposit","b",-2)], "a")
except ValueError as e:
    print('ledger negative   ->', type(e).__name__)
print('ledger net        :', led.balance([("deposit","a",100),("withdraw","a",30)], "a"))

print('intervals sub norm :', iv.Impl().subtract([[5,7],[1,3]], (2,6)))

print('flags terminator   :', fl.Impl().parse(["--","--x","y"]))
